title: Sales Redetermination Events
purpose: Make recalculation triggers explicit. A mechanism is only half the story; the other half is knowing when SAP keeps an old value and when it calculates again.

events.title: Create document without reference
events.trigger: A new sales document starts without a preceding sales document.
events.kept_or_copied: No predecessor business data is available to copy.
events.diagnostic_question: Which current master or mechanism supplied this value?

events.title: Create document with reference
events.trigger: A target sales document is created from an inquiry, quotation, order, or another allowed predecessor.
events.kept_or_copied: Relevant predecessor data is copied. Later changes to master data do not automatically replace values already copied from the predecessor.
rechecked: newly entered target items can read current master data
copy-control-dependent values can be redetermined according to configuration
events.diagnostic_question: Did this value come from today's master data or yesterday's predecessor?

events.title: Change sales document type
events.trigger: An allowed alternative sales document type is selected during document processing.
events.kept_or_copied: The change is only allowed when key control settings are compatible, including partner and text procedure constraints.
rechecked: pricing when the document determination procedure differs
material determination when its procedure differs
free goods when its procedure differs
events.diagnostic_question: Which procedure changed with the document type, and which result therefore had to be rebuilt?

events.title: Change delivering plant
events.trigger: The order item receives a different plant through redetermination or manual change.
events.kept_or_copied: Do not assume shipping results remain valid just because the item still exists.
rechecked: intercompany or legal context where relevant
events.diagnostic_question: What downstream logistics decisions consumed the old plant?

events.title: Change or substitute material
events.trigger: The entered product changes or material determination substitutes another product.
events.kept_or_copied: Commercial intent may stay the same while the product-dependent control context changes.
events.diagnostic_question: Which downstream result still belongs to the old material context?

events.title: Change partner context
events.trigger: Sold-to, ship-to, bill-to, payer, or another business partner changes.
events.kept_or_copied: Some document values may already have been copied from the old partner context.
events.diagnostic_question: Which fields were copied from the old partner and which mechanisms actively redetermined?
